engineer_actions: Resolve syntax, NP4 affinity and architecture oracle

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Criteria references undefined Intel/AMD spec for NVIDIA HPL-AI; NP4 supplies eight GPU/memory/CPU affinity entries, and both Docker lines contain a backslash followed by a space that breaks normal shell continuation.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Static review is complete; execution awaits explicit syntax/affinity/oracle decisions and packages.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Compatibility row282 Wistron-NV GPU-00275-V003: approve corrected shell continuation, define how NP4 uses eight GPU/memory/CPU affinity entries versus NP8, validate GPU/NUMA/CPU 0-111 topology, and replace/map Intel/AMD spec to NVIDIA HPL-AI accuracy/residual/GFLOPS/scaling thresholds for both data files.

review_improvement: Preserves HPL-AI coverage while exposing command and affinity ambiguity and requiring a valid mixed-precision accuracy/performance oracle.
independent_technical_reasoning: HPL-AI performance and numerical validity depend on mixed-precision refinement, rank placement and memory locality. Eight affinity entries with four MPI ranks may be intentional multi-GPU-per-rank behavior or a copied NP8 map; executing without authority changes coverage. A backslash with trailing whitespace does not reliably continue a shell line, and CPU vendor specs cannot define GPU HPL-AI acceptance without an explicit mapping.
